description:
• About our brand and products: we offer gardening seeds for the Canadian climate. 
• What makes us different: our focus is on open pollinated, heirloom and hybrid seeds that thrive in Canada. We offer free shipping in Canada, 4% rewards back to customers and fast turn around time. 
• How affiliates can earn: 6% on purchases
• How to promote us: social media, websites, emails
• Other information: we also offer customers 10% off their first order to encourage action.
payout_period: We pay commissions quarterly, the first week of January, April, July, October.
categories: Home & Tools, Garden & Outdoors, Wellness & Lifestyle
term_and_condition:
As an affiliate partner with Circle Farms, it is crucial to uphold the values of respect and professionalism. We require that all affiliated content adhere to these principles by explicitly prohibiting any promotion of hate, sexual content, or inappropriate language. Content that includes or endorses discriminatory, offensive, or explicit material will not be tolerated. Affiliates must ensure that their channels maintain a positive and respectful environment.


Circle Farms reserves the right to review and monitor affiliated content to ensure compliance with these terms. If any content is found to violate these guidelines, we will promptly address the issue and may take corrective actions, including but not limited to the suspension or termination of the affiliate’s participation in the program. Our aim is to foster a community of affiliates who share our dedication to ethical and responsible content creation.


By participating in our affiliate program, you agree to adhere to these content guidelines and to promote our products in a manner consistent with our values. We appreciate your cooperation in helping us maintain a positive and respectful platform for all viewers.


As a Circle Farms affiliate, you may share any content that we have published and we reserve the right to share any Circle Farms related content that you share (while always crediting you). 


Circle Farms reserves the right to amend or cancel the program at any time. Any changes to commission rates will not be retroactive, and cancellation of the program will not negate any past commissions earned.
